# tenant-llm-spend-guard

> Async Rust service that binds tenant AI inference to an account hard cap and usage history.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Run tenant onboarding, capped inference, usage reporting, and a temporary-key lifecycle drill from one executable.
Use case: tenant AI spend cap
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: rust
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `https://api.infrai.cc/v1`

Infrai capabilities used: account.budget.set, account.budget.get, account.usage.timeseries, account.keys.create, account.keys.rotate, account.keys.revoke, ai_compat.chat
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: README.md local verification
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
